forecast-period.text: A weak high pressure system about the west coast will move across the state today. A trough of low pressure and cold front move into the west late this evening and cross the remainder of of South Australia on Sunday. Another cold front clips the southeast on Monday, followed by a high pressure system, which will then move across southern parts of the state on Tuesday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Patchy morning fog possible about the Eyre Peninsula, the Flinders and Mid North districts. Light morning showers possible about southern coasts and the southeast. Showers and possible thunderstorms developing in the west from the evening and more broadly about the agricultural areas overnight. Maximum temperatures above to well above average statewide. Light winds in the east tending north to northwesterly during the day. Freshening northeast to northwesterly winds in the west ahead of a west to southwesterly change in the far west late.

Showers and isolated thunderstorms about the agricultural areas and adjacent parts to the north, contracting to the northeast later. Isolated showers redevelop about the southern agricultural area late. Maximum temperatures well above average in the east, tending to below average in the far west. Fresh north to northwesterly winds in the east ahead of a fresh and gusty west to southwesterly change extending throughout during the day.

Isolated showers about the southern agricultural area, clearing by the evening. Showers and thunderstorms about the far northeast. Maximum temperatures below average, tending to above average in the far northeast. West to southwesterly winds about coastal areas, fresh at times. Winds tending south to southeasterly winds elsewhere, freshening at times further north.

text.p: Afternoon showers and thunderstorms about the far north. Maximum temperatures below average. Southwest to southeasterly winds, tending easterly in the west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Tuesday: Less than 2 mm about the north and west. 2 to 5 mm about the agricultural areas with local falls of 5 to 15 mm possible about southern coast sand the far northeast. Localised falls between 15 to 30 mm are possible with thunderstorms about the east.
